correctness.rationale: For a finite spider, hub-zero eigenvectors restrict to normalized Dirichlet sine modes on each arm; an eigenvalue indexed by reduced b/q is shared by precisely the shifted lengths divisible by q. The single nonzero hub-amplitude constraint removes one of c_q arm coefficient dimensions. The site diagonal of the resulting projector is (2/L_i)sin²(pi bt/q)[1-1/(L_i W_q)]. Summing primitive numerators gives the integer Ramanujan expression; nonnegative factors vanish exactly when all shared q divide t, equivalent to lcm_j gcd(L_i,L_j)|t. Dark dimension sum phi(q)(c_q-1) and mixed-state absorption follow from orthogonal spectral decomposition. Independent direct symmetric-adjacency projector for arm lengths (1,3,5) gave dark dimension 2 and 4 bright vertices, consistent with exact formula. Positive hopping/loss rates affect transient, not projection.
